title: PagedAttention for KV cache
text: PagedAttention treats KV cache like virtual memory pages, eliminating 60-80% fragmentation. Used in vLLM and SGLang.

title: RadixAttention prefix caching
text: RadixAttention stores KV in a prefix trie; cache hit on shared prefix lets the engine skip prefill. Implemented in SGLang.

title: Disaggregated serving architecture
text: Disaggregated serving (Mooncake, llm-d, Dynamo) splits prefill and decode onto separate GPU pools for better resource utilization.

title: Goodput vs throughput
text: Goodput@SLO = req/s satisfying TTFT and TPOT SLOs. Throughput at saturation ignores SLO and measures peak capacity.

title: GGUF quantization for edge
text: GGUF Q4_K_M is the production-quality default for laptop/edge serving via llama.cpp. Balances quality and memory.

title: Time to first token
text: TTFT (Time To First Token) measures prefill latency. Critical for user-perceived responsiveness in chat applications.

title: Time per output token
text: TPOT (Time Per Output Token) measures decode speed. Affects streaming smoothness and total generation time.

title: KV cache management
text: KV cache stores key-value pairs from attention layers. Proper management via paging or quantization reduces memory waste.

title: Continuous batching
text: Continuous batching allows new requests to join mid-generation, maximizing GPU utilization compared to static batching.

title: Metal backend for Apple Silicon
text: Metal backend in llama.cpp leverages unified memory on M1/M2/M3 chips for efficient inference without discrete GPU.
